Middleton Rural Fire District Temporary Levy

referendum.text:
Shall the Board of Commissioners of the Middleton Rural Fire District be authorized and empowered to a TEMPORARY increase to its annual budget levy for a period of two years, commencing Fiscal Year 2027, pursuant to Idaho Code Section 63-802(3)? The Middleton Rural Fire District has grown by 27% since 2020. Annual calls for emergency services have increased from 1,500 in 2020 to over 2,000 in 2025 and unit response times continue to increase. The increased demand for emergency services has outpaced the District's manpower and annual budget authority.

Due to legislation passed in 2020 to decrease property taxes, the District's limited annual budget authority has NOT kept up and an increase is necessary to cover personnel and annual operating costs. The requested increase will also fund firefighter safety equipment, the annual cost of full-time staffing and operating expenses for the new station located on Harvey Rd. that is being constructed with Impact Fees paid by new development.
